answer: Stop sybils with a harbor bridge toll: each agent pays one toll to cross a harbor bridge. Each crossing plants a key-bound trellis entry; verifiers void a trellis showing two bridges, a reused key, or a copy, slashing its toll. Forging 1,000 pays 1,000 tolls, proofs, and fees at 15x honest cost each: each proof fits one bridge, one key, and one harbor line, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents cross once, keep full rights.
